title: fused_linear_cross_entropy_loss accumulates gradient in bf16 by default — silently noisier than fp32 accumulation
root_cause: The liger-kernel fused linear+CE call defaulted accum_grad to bf16, which silently degraded gradient precision on the LM head. The numerical noise was small enough that training continued, but it shifted loss curves vs the unfused baseline.
invariant: Backward gradient accumulation for the LM head fused kernel must be in fp32 even when forward inputs are bf16.
diff_summary: Pass accum_grad=fp32 explicitly into the fused_linear_cross_entropy_loss call and bump liger-kernel.
